integrity: The proof is supplied in full; formula origins are credited, numerical tests are reproducible, and this result has no independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Sharp extremizers apply only to enriched chain polytopes of complete layered posets with fixed number of positive-size levels and fixed total dimension. Previous Hanner results supply general covariance recursions; unindexed earlier discrete majorization inequalities could affect priority. Finite numerical/hull checks support, not replace, the all-dimensional proof.
title: Strict isotropic majorization for enriched layered chain polytopes
